description: Hand-labeled near-duplicate passage pairs. doc_key + a distinguishing text snippet is used because chunk_ids are only assigned at ingestion time (scripts/resolve_ground_truth.py maps these to real chunk ids after chunking).

cases.snippet_a: Employees must submit leave requests at least 48 hours before the planned absence
cases.snippet_b: Leave applications should be submitted two days before the planned absence
cases.notes: Same policy fact (leave notice period) stated independently in two documents of different authority levels (Policy vs Handbook). Should surface as a duplicate cluster and flag the handbook as the lower-authority restatement.

cases.snippet_a: All company-issued laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled before they are used to access internal systems
cases.snippet_b: Full disk encryption must be enabled on every company laptop before the device is handed over to an employee
cases.notes: Same encryption requirement duplicated across the Security Policy and the Device Policy. Both authority_level 1/2 -- illustrates duplicate detection is orthogonal to authority ranking.
